conditions.judge: Consider `answer`. Does it have wheels as part of what it is?

levels.yes: It has wheels; they are part of what it is.
levels.partly: Some kinds have wheels and some don't.

conditions.judge: Consider `answer`. Is it powered by a motor or engine of its own?

levels.yes: It runs on its own motor or engine.
levels.partly: Some kinds have a motor and some don't.
levels.no: No motor or engine: people, animals, wind, or nothing move it.

conditions.judge: Consider `answer`. Can a person ride on it or in it while it moves?

levels.yes: People ride on it or in it as it moves.
levels.partly: Only some kinds, only children, or only in an unusual way.
levels.no: Nobody rides on it or in it.
